statement: An LG1 quasigroup is an LG3 quasigroup.

top_abstractions: fn_1(A, B, C) = rdiv(C, ldiv(B, A))
fn_2(A, B) = fn_1(ldiv(rdiv(ldiv(B, B), A), A))
fn_3(A, B, C) = ldiv(C, op(op(C, B), A))
fn_4(A, B, C) = op(rdiv(B, A), C)
fn_5(A, B, C, D) = ldiv(C, op(C, fn_4(B, D, A)))
fn_6(A, B, C) = ldiv(C, rdiv(op(C, B), A))
fn_7(A, B, C) = C(op(B, C(B, A)), A)
fn_9(A, B, C) = op(C, ldiv(B, A))
expanded_abstractions: fn_5 = ldiv(C, op(C, op(rdiv(D, B), A)))

top_abstractions: fn_1(A, B, C, D) = rdiv(B, ldiv(A, ldiv(rdiv(ldiv(D, D), C), C)))
fn_2(A, B, C) = ldiv(A, op(op(A, B), C))
fn_4(A, B, C) = op(rdiv(A, B), C)
expanded_abstractions: fn_1 = rdiv(B, ldiv(A, ldiv(rdiv(ldiv(D, D), C), C)))
